tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa g.yul las rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya kañca na ba ti nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa g.yul las rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das lhas ma lta bu na/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das g.yul ngor mchis te g.yul 'gyed na/ lha ma yin gyi sgyu dang*/ rig sngags rnams dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ sman dag gis pham par gyur na/ mkhyen lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rjes su bzung ba dang*/ bdag cag la thugs brtse ba dang*/ lha ma yin rnams kyi sgyu dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ sman rab tu gzhom pa dang*/ rab tu gzhig pa'i slad du rnam par rgyal ba'i gsang sngags chen po legs par bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// ko'u shi ka de de bzhin no// lha ma yin dang g.yul sprad pa na/ rig sngags rnams dang*/ gsang sngags rnams dang*/ sman rnams kyis pham pa de bzhin te/ ko'u shi ka snying brtse ba'i phyir rig sngags brjod par bya ste/ sgyu thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad bzlog pa/ gsang sngags thams cad rengs par byed pa/ 'thab pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ mtshang 'bru ba dang*/ 'thab mo dang*/ 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ gsang sngags dang*/ sman thams cad gcod pa'i rig sngags bshad par bya'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe rig sngags chen po gser can bka' stsal pa/ gang bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du/

gzhan mu stegs can spyod pa ba dang*/ kun du rgyu dang*/ gcer bu ba rnams kyis ngan song du bsams shing*/ bar chad du byas pa las/ de tshun chad sgyu dang ldan pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis rig sngags 'chang thams cad bzlog nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byas te/ gzhan mu stegs can spyod pa ba dang*/ kun du rgyu ba/ gcer bu ba dang*/ 'tshe ba rnams kyi sgyu dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ sman dang*/ bdud kyi sde thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i rig pa chen po de ngas bshad par bya ste/ ko'u shi ka khyod kyis sems can thams cad rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ gsang sngags chen mo rnam par rgyal ba chen mo zungs shig /bcom ldan 'das de de bzhin no zhes gsol te/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin bcom ldan 'das kyis ltar mnyan pa dang*/ de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyis ltar nyan pa de'i tshe/ rig sngags chen mo gser can 'di dag bka' stsal to// tad+ya thā/ oṃ hi li hi li ni/ hi li hi li/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ mi li mi li/ hi ni hi ni/ ni hi ra bi ni/ kā na tsi ba ti/ lo kā mā ti/ bha te bha'u gu ta man tra/ a ti kri ti be de be de/ da ta man tra/ a dhi kra ti/ ha na ha na/ ha sa ha sa/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bha ga ba ti/ dza ye bi dza ye/ dzam bha ni/ stam bha ni/ ban+dha ni/ mo ha ni/ oṃ mo gha sha ka ti dha na ni/ gṛ h+ṇa gri h+ṇa/ kā ṭā ma ma na si/ dzam+bha ya/ dzam+bha ya/ bhañja ya/ bhañja ya/ bhañja ya/ stam+bha ya/ ban+dha ya/ ban+dha/ mo ha ya/ mo ha ya/ lha'i sgyu dang*/ klu'i sgyu dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sgyu dang*/ srin po'i sgyu dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi sgyu dang*/ dri za'i sgyu dang*/ lha ma yin gyi sgyu dang*/ mi'am ci'i sgyu dang*/ lto 'phye chen po'i sgyu dang*/ rig sngags kyi sgyu dang*/ rig sngags 'chang grub pa'i rgyal po'i sgyu dang*/ drang srong gi sgyu dang*/ sems can rig sngags 'chang ba thams cad kyi sgyu dang*/

'byung po'i sgyu dang*/ sgyu thams cad/ ra la dza la/ rad dza rad dza/ dha ma dha ma/ dhu dhu ma/ rā ba rā ba/ ra ba ṇe tsakra nā ma/ grā na tha na/ ha na ha na/ sarba bid+ya/ shā dru 'u nān/ stam bha ya/ bha yuṃ stam bha ya/ ru 'u r+yaṃ stam bha ya/ so nan stam bha ya/ bu ru ṇan/ stam bha ya/ ag na ni stam bha ya/ ud shan dhi/ ti dhi ri/ dha ra ṇi/ ba sha ha ste/ bi ྴྟ ya na pa she na/ gang dag bdag la phyir rgol ba rnams dang*/ dgra rnams dang*/ sdang ba dang*/ rab tu sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ rab tu 'thab pa dang*/ mi phan par 'dod pa thams cad/ ha na ha na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhan dza ya bhan dza ya/ stam bha ya/ ban dha ya ban dha ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ ma hā mo ha ni/ bha ga wa te swā hā/ bdag 'jigs pa dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba thams cad las srungs shig /ko'u shi ka rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rgyal po'am/ rgyal po chen po gang la la zhig gser can gyi rig sngags 'di rjes su dran par byed na/ de la pha rol gyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*// de'i sde de la pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis mi tshugs so// lhas ma yin/ klus ma yin/ gnod sbyin gyis ma yin/ srin pos ma yin/ dri zas ma yin/ lha ma yin gyis ma yin/ nam mkha' lding gis ma yin/ mi'am cis ma yin/ rig sngags 'chang gis ma yin/ mkha' 'gro mas ma yin/ dus ma yin par 'chi bas dus byed pa mi 'gyur/ rig sngags dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ sman rnams kyis mi tshugs/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis mi tshugs so// pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro// lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ lus la me dang*/ chu dang*/ dug dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ sman rnams kyis mi tshugs so// gang gis sdig pa byas pa dang*/ byed du bcug pa dang*/ rjes su yi rangs pa de nyid la slar 'bab par 'gyur/ de nyid slar 'gro bar 'gyur ro// ko'u shi ka de lta bas na dad pa'i dge slong ngam/

dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mos rig sngags 'di chu la lan bdun bzlas te/ bdag gi lus la blugs na/ bdag gis lus ma lus par bsrung bar 'gyur ro// 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad dang*/ yams kyi nad dang*/ nad 'go ba thams cad dang*/ rig sngags thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ sman thams cad dang*/ byad thams cad las shin tu 'das par 'dod pas/ gser can gyi rig sngags 'di dran par bya'o// rgyal po'am/ rgyal po'i blon po pha rol gyi dmag tshogs gzhom pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'dul bar 'dod pas/ gser can gyi rig sngags 'di dran par lan bdun bzlas te/ mdud pa bdun bor ba'i srad bu gdags par bya 'am/ chu la lan bdun bzlas pas bsrung bar bya'o// 'jigs pa thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i gzungs 'di yi ger bris te 'chang bar mgul du gdags par bya'o// yi ger bris nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor gdags par bya'o// g.yul du zhugs pa na dge ba dang*/ bde bar thar bar 'gyur ro// rig sngags 'di'i stobs kyis nang mi dang*/ g.yog 'khor dang*/ sde dang bcas te dge ba dang bde bar rgal bar 'gyur ro// ma grub pa rnams kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro// rig sngags rengs par byed pas// srad bu dkar po la lan bdun bzlas te/ mdud pa bdun bor na/ bcing ba dang rengs par byas par 'gyur ro// sgyu rengs par byed 'dod pas/ dur khrod kyi sa la lan bdun bzlas te gtor na sgyu rengs par byed par 'gyur ro// 'gyed pa'i tshe kha lkugs par byed pas thig le la lan bdun du bzlas te 'chos na/ smra ba thams cad la lan thebs par 'gyur ro// bklag par bya/ kha ton du bya/ brjod par bya ste/ chus bdag bsrungs/ brjod pa tsam gyis sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro// gang gis byas par gyur pa dang*/ gang gis bsams par gyur pa nyid la slar 'gro'o// srad bu la btags sam/

chus bdag bsrungs par byas nas de'i lus la rig sngags dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ sman thams cad kyis mi tshugs so// ma grub pa rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro// de thams cad kyang mthun par 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa g.yul las rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /
